data.description: The Fun Walker Double is an air walker for two people. Each user stands on an orange foot pedal and swings the legs forward and back in a walking motion while holding the frame. It gives a low-impact cardio workout that is easy on the knees. That makes it one of the first machines we suggest for a park, a walking track or a senior citizens' area. With two walkers on one frame, friends or couples can exercise side by side. Its footprint and warranty terms come with your quotation. On the Fun Walker Double, our standard terms would give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and we will confirm this in writing. Tell us how many walkers your track gets in the morning and we will suggest a mix.

items.pText: The Fun Walker Double is an air walker for two people. Each user stands on an orange foot pedal and swings the legs forward and back in a walking motion while holding the frame. It gives a low-impact cardio workout that is easy on the knees. That makes it one of the first machines we suggest for a park, a walking track or a senior citizens' area. With two walkers on one frame, friends or couples can exercise side by side. Its footprint and warranty terms come with your quotation. On the Fun Walker Double, our standard terms would give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, and we will confirm this in writing. Tell us how many walkers your track gets in the morning and we will suggest a mix.

Air walkers swing on bearings at the top of each pedal arm, so these need regular checks for noise and play. We set the double frame self-standing or grouted. Leave clear space in front of and behind the pedals, because the swing reaches further than people expect.
